role: previously unused validation parents, prospective no-NN regime check; NOT locked validation
source_hypothesis: At K12 with shared TV multiplier0.1, weak background and amplitude1.2 show >=10% mean delta-material benefit of F over L; require independent matched no-NN validation.
hypothesis: At K12, weak background, amplitude1.2 and common TV multiplier0.1: equal-parent relative delta-material improvement of F versus L is at least10%.
comparison_definition: For each parent average the two noise-condition delta NRMSE values within each arm, then compute1-F/L; average16 paired parents equally.
decision_reporting: Complete required pairs only; report point target PASS/FAIL/HOLD and ci95 position relative to10% separately. No changes to existing A24/A25 gates.

label_provenance.label_cost: already paid in independent-dataset-generation-001; not free labels
label_provenance.fullwave_prediction_audits: new estimate audits charged; not new clean truth labels
label_provenance.current_labels: archived full-wave current, accessible only to offline scoring

information_boundary: Builder and optimizer receive only known background/cache and OnlineObservation(data,sigma,case_id). No clean/truth/current/noise realization or archived initializer enters proposals.
data_exposure: All16 validation parents become declared development/validation evidence; never untouched locked NN test.
wall_stop_policy: Cooperative check before/after charged actions at285s, reserve15s for failure/partial artifacts and summary. Native calls cannot be preempted; overshoot is recorded and never hidden.
timing_scope: Inclusive charged CPU job including geometry, shared background, all methods, initialization, all proposal trials, full-wave prediction audits, I/O and bootstrap. Per-image online times are descriptive; no cold/warm speed claim.
order_rule: Ascending frozen parentIDs, clean then20dB; cyclic method rotation by(parent_id+noise_index)mod3; no metric-dependent ordering.

randomness.noise: reuse archived realizations; no new draws

physical_scope: 24x24 2D TM;8sources/32receivers; known weak background; archived passive phase(1+0.2i)/abs(1+0.2i); no3D/vector-Maxwell/unknown-background or NN claim

frozen_runtime.tv_rule: lambda=0.01*(1+sigma/background_data_RMS); normalized data loss .5||W residual||^2/||W yb||^2; same physical prior in every arm
frozen_runtime.step_rule: 0.8/lambda_max(Jb^T Jb/||yb||^2) in real mass coordinates; single global fixed step per background
frozen_runtime.initialization: one common background linear-adjoint gradient step followed by the same constrained TV proximal
